questions.q_en: In a family, the combined age of husband, wife and a son is 90 years. The husband is the oldest. The difference in the ages of the husband and wife is the age of their son. After 10 years, the age of the son would be half the age of his father. What is the present age of his mother [in years]?
questions.q_hi: एक परिवार में पति, पत्नी और बेटे की संयुक्त आयु 90 वर्ष है। पति सबसे बड़ा है। पति और पत्नी की आयु में अंतर उनके बेटे की आयु का है। 10 वर्ष बाद, बेटे की आयु उसके पिता की आयु की आधी होगी। उसकी माँ की वर्तमान आयु [वर्षों में] क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
Let age of husband, wife and son = H, W, S
H + W + S = 90
W = 90 – H – S -------- {i}
H – W = S
W = H – S -------- {ii}
From {i} & {ii} eqn ----
90 - H - S = H – S
270 = 6H + 2S -------- {iii}
→ From question – [H + 10] = 2[S+10]
H + 10 = 2S + 20
2S = H – 10 ------- {iv}
From eqn {iii} & {iv}
270 = 6H + H – 10
7H = 280
H = 40
2S = 270 – 6 × 40
S = 15 yr.
W = 40 – ×15 = 35 yrs
questions.solution_hi:
पति, पत्नी और बेटे की आयु = H, W, S
H + W + S = 90
W = 90 – H – S -------- {i}
H – W = S
W = H - S -------- {ii}
{i} और {ii} समीकरण से ----
90 - H - S = H - S
270 = 6H + 2S -------- {iii}
→ प्रश्न से – [H + 10] = 2[S+10]
H + 10 = 2S + 20
2S = H – 10 ------- {iv}
समीकरण {iii} और {iv} से
270 = 6H + H – 10
7H = 280
H = 40
2S = 270 – 6 × 40
S = 15 वर्ष.
W= 40 - ×15 = 35 वर्ष

questions.q_en: Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of Tarun and Saurabh was 4 : 1. After five years, the ratio of their ages will be 2 : 1. What is the present age of Saurabh [in years]?
questions.q_hi: पाँच वर्ष पहले, तरुण और सौरभ की आयु का अनुपात 4 : 1 था। पाँच वर्ष बाद, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 2 : 1 होगा। सौरभ की वर्तमान आयु [वर्षों में] क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
To equal the diff. of ratio we will multiply ratios with opp. Differences.
4 : 1 × 1        4 : 1
2 : 1 × 3        6 : 3

2 ratio = 10 yr.
1 ratio = 5 yr.
Saurabh Present age = 2ratio
= 2 × 5 = 10 yrs.
questions.solution_hi:
अनुपात के अंतर को बराबर करने के लिए हम अनुपातों को विपरीत अंतरों से गुणा करेंगे।
4 : 1 × 1        4 : 1
2 : 1 × 3        6 : 3

2 ratio = 10 yr.
1 ratio = 5 yr.
सौरभ वर्तमान आयु = 2 ratio
= 2 × 5 = 10 yrs.

questions.q_en: Seven years from now, Anamika will be as old as Malini was 4 years ago. Srinidhi was born 2 years ago. The average age of Anamika, Malini and Srinidhi 10 years from now will be 33 years. What is the present age of Anamika ?

A + 7= M - 4 -------------- {i}
Today Avg of A + M + S = 33 - 10 = 23
As Srinidhi was born 2 years ago, => S=2
A + M + 2 = [23] × 3
A + M = 69 - 2
= 67
M = 67- A ---------{ii}
From {i} & {ii}
A + 7= 67- A - 4
2A = 56
A = 28 yrs
